name: Arctic Stud Poker Run
summary: A combination of poker and combat racing, Arctic Stud Poker Run puts you in the driver's seat of an all-terrain vehicle, and challenges you to assemble a winning poker hand from cards scattered around the track, while heavily-armed opponents try to grab cards before you. Any destroyed opponent will drop his cards, and there are plenty of weapons for the taking on the track, along with assorted power-ups. A single-player tournament (featuring over 100 levels), and multi-player options are both included.
